///
/// The list is small (a dozen or so rows), so the DAO is the plain cour/step
/// shape: ordered reads, one reactive watch, and a soft delete. Ordering is
/// `order_index` first — the seed order, and whatever the user reorders it to —
/// then the name, so two rows added at the same position still read A→Z.
library;

import 'package:drift/drift.dart';

import '../../../../database/app_database.dart';

/// Data Access Object for [Laws] table operations.
class LawsDao {
  /// Creates a DAO backed by [db].
  LawsDao(this.db);

  /// The Drift database instance.
  final AppDatabase db;

  /// Returns all non-deleted law names in display order.
  Future<List<Law>> getAll({int? limit, int? offset}) async {
    final query = db.select(db.laws)
      ..where((row) => row.isDeleted.equals(false))
      ..orderBy([
        (row) => OrderingTerm(expression: row.orderIndex),
        (row) => OrderingTerm(expression: row.name),
      ]);
    if (limit != null) {
      query.limit(limit, offset: offset ?? 0);
    }
    return query.get();
  }

  /// Reactive stream of all non-deleted law names in display order.
  Stream<List<Law>> watchAll({int? limit, int? offset}) {
    final query = db.select(db.laws)
      ..where((row) => row.isDeleted.equals(false))
      ..orderBy([
        (row) => OrderingTerm(expression: row.orderIndex),
        (row) => OrderingTerm(expression: row.name),
      ]);
    if (limit != null) {
      query.limit(limit, offset: offset ?? 0);
    }
    return query.watch();
  }

  /// Returns a law name by id, or null if not found or deleted.
  Future<Law?> getById(String id) async => (db.select(db.laws)
        ..where((row) => row.id.equals(id) & row.isDeleted.equals(false)))
      .getSingleOrNull();

  /// Returns the highest `order_index` in use, or -1 when the list is empty.
  ///
  /// A new name appends after it, so a freshly typed law never lands at the
  /// top of the list or shares position 0 with the whole seed.
  Future<int> maxOrderIndex() async {
    final row = await (db.selectOnly(db.laws)
          ..addColumns([db.laws.orderIndex.max()])
          ..where(db.laws.isDeleted.equals(false)))
        .getSingle();
    return row.read(db.laws.orderIndex.max()) ?? -1;
  }

  /// Inserts a law name. Returns the affected row count.
  Future<int> insert(LawsCompanion law) => db.into(db.laws).insert(law);

  /// Updates a law name. Returns true if a row was affected.
  Future<bool> update(LawsCompanion law) async =>
      await (db.update(
        db.laws,
      )..where((row) => row.id.equals(law.id.value))).write(law) >
      0;

  /// Soft-deletes a law name by id.
  Future<int> delete(String id, int updatedAt) =>
      (db.update(db.laws)..where((row) => row.id.equals(id))).write(
        LawsCompanion(
          isDeleted: const Value(true),
          updatedAt: Value(updatedAt),
        ),
      );
}

class LocalLawsRepository with BaseLocalRepository implements LawsRepository {
  final LawsDao _dao;

  @override
  final SyncWriteHelper syncHelper;

  LocalLawsRepository(this._dao, this.syncHelper);

  @override
  Future<String> insert(LawsCompanion companion) async {
    final now = BaseLocalRepository.nowMillis;
    final id = const Uuid().v4();
    final userId = currentUserId;

    final finalCompanion = companion.copyWith(
      id: Value(id),
      isCustom: const Value(true),
      isUserModified: const Value(false),
      userId: Value(userId),
      // The server stamps the firm a shared list belongs to; the client never
      // invents one, exactly as the court list does.
      firmId: const Value<String?>(null),
      // A name typed by the user goes to the end of the list unless the caller
      // asked for a position (a reorder does that through `update`).
      orderIndex: companion.orderIndex.present
          ? companion.orderIndex
          : Value(await _dao.maxOrderIndex() + 1),
      updatedAt: Value(now),
      lastModifiedBy: Value(userId),
    );

    await _dao.insert(finalCompanion);

    final inserted = await _dao.getById(id);
    final payload = BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(inserted!.toJson());
    await syncHelper.recordInsert(
      entityType: 'law',
      entityId: id,
      payload: payload,
      changedFields: payload.keys.toList(),
    );

    return id;
  }

  @override
  Future<void> update(LawsCompanion companion, {Law? base}) async {
    final id = companion.id.value;
    final existing = base ?? await _dao.getById(id);

      throw StateError('Cannot update law $id: not found');
    }

    final now = BaseLocalRepository.nowMillis;
    final userId = currentUserId;

    final finalCompanion = companion.copyWith(
      isUserModified: const Value(true),
      updatedAt: Value(now),
      lastModifiedBy: Value(userId),
    );

    await _dao.update(finalCompanion);

    final updated = await _dao.getById(id);
    final payload = BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(updated!.toJson());
    final changed = _changedFields(finalCompanion);

    await syncHelper.recordUpdate(
      entityType: 'law',
      entityId: id,
      payload: payload,
      changedFields: changed,
      basePayload: BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(existing.toJson()),
      baseVersion: existing.version,
      preMutationPayload: BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(existing.toJson()),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<void> delete(Law law) async {
    if (!law.isCustom) {
      throw StateError('Cannot delete built-in law ${law.id}');
    }
    final now = BaseLocalRepository.nowMillis;
    final userId = currentUserId;

    await _dao.delete(law.id, now);

    await syncHelper.recordDelete(
      entityType: 'law',
      entityId: law.id,
      payload: BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(<String, dynamic>{
        'id': law.id,
        'isDeleted': true,
        'updatedAt': now,
        'lastModifiedBy': userId,
      }),
      changedFields: ['is_deleted', 'updated_at', 'last_modified_by'],
      basePayload: BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(law.toJson()),
      baseVersion: law.version,
      preMutationPayload: BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(law.toJson()),
    );
  }

  Future<Law?> getById(String id) => _dao.getById(id);

    if (companion.name.present) fields.add('name');
    if (companion.orderIndex.present) fields.add('order_index');
    return fields;
  }

+/// Laws table: the editable list of Act/Statute names a case reference cites.
+///
+/// Table class (AGENTS.md rule 4): **push/pull domain** — editable and
+/// firm-shared in firm mode, exactly like `courts`. The app ships a default
+/// list under stable seed ids, and a user (or their chamber) may add a name of
+/// their own; a built-in row may be renamed but never deleted.
+///
+/// This table holds the *names* only. A case reference keeps its statute as
+/// text, so an existing row still shows what it always showed even if the law
+/// list changes — the list supplies the dropdown's options and the display
+/// order, nothing else.
+library;
+
+import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
+
+/// One law (Act, Ordinance or Statute) a case reference may cite.
+@DataClassName('Law')
+class Laws extends Table {
+  /// Stable seed id for a built-in law, or a UUID for a user-added one.
+  TextColumn get id => text()();
+
+  /// Display name, e.g. `Penal Code`.
+  TextColumn get name => text()();
+
+  /// Display order; seeded laws keep their seed order, a new name is appended.
+  IntColumn get orderIndex => integer().withDefault(const Constant(0))();
+
+  /// True if added by the user/firm; false if pre-seeded.
+  BoolColumn get isCustom => boolean().withDefault(const Constant(false))();
+
+  /// Whether the user/firm has renamed a pre-seeded law.
+  BoolColumn get isUserModified =>
+      boolean().withDefault(const Constant(false))();
+
+  /// Creator of a custom law; null for pre-seeded rows.
+  TextColumn get userId => text().nullable()();
+
+  /// Firm scope; null for individuals & pre-seeded rows.
+  TextColumn get firmId => text().nullable()();
+
+  // Global sync columns.
+  IntColumn get updatedAt => integer()();
+  IntColumn get version => integer().nullable()();
+  IntColumn get syncedAt => integer().nullable()();
+  BoolColumn get isDeleted => boolean().withDefault(const Constant(false))();
+  TextColumn get lastModifiedBy => text().nullable()();
+
+  @override
+  Set<Column> get primaryKey => {id};
+}

+/// Law names repository.
+///
+/// The law list is one of the editable reference lists (AGENTS.md rule 10):
+/// push/pull domain, firm-shared in firm mode, and seeded with the app's
+/// defaults. Its three write rules are the court list's, one for one — an
+/// insert marks the row custom, an update marks it user-modified so a later
+/// seed cannot overwrite the edit, and a delete refuses a built-in row.
+library;
+
+import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
+import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';
+
+import '../../../core/repositories/base_local_repository.dart';
+import '../../../database/app_database.dart';
+import '../../../sync/sync_write_helper.dart';
+import 'local/laws_dao.dart';
+
+/// Law names repository interface.
+abstract class LawsRepository {
+  Future<String> insert(LawsCompanion companion);
+  Future<void> update(LawsCompanion companion, {Law? base});
+  Future<void> delete(Law law);
+  Future<Law?> getById(String id);
+  Future<List<Law>> listAll({int? limit, int? offset});
+  Stream<List<Law>> watchAll({int? limit, int? offset});
+}
+
+/// Local Drift-backed implementation of [LawsRepository].
+class LocalLawsRepository with BaseLocalRepository implements LawsRepository {
+  final LawsDao _dao;
+
+  @override
+  final SyncWriteHelper syncHelper;
+
+  LocalLawsRepository(this._dao, this.syncHelper);
+
+  @override
+  Future<String> insert(LawsCompanion companion) async {
+    final now = BaseLocalRepository.nowMillis;
+    final id = const Uuid().v4();
+    final userId = currentUserId;
+
+    final finalCompanion = companion.copyWith(
+      id: Value(id),
+      isCustom: const Value(true),
+      isUserModified: const Value(false),
+      userId: Value(userId),
+      // The server stamps the firm a shared list belongs to; the client never
+      // invents one, exactly as the court list does.
+      firmId: const Value<String?>(null),
+      // A name typed by the user goes to the end of the list unless the caller
+      // asked for a position (a reorder does that through `update`).
+      orderIndex: companion.orderIndex.present
+          ? companion.orderIndex
+          : Value(await _dao.maxOrderIndex() + 1),
+      updatedAt: Value(now),
+      lastModifiedBy: Value(userId),
+    );
+
+    await _dao.insert(finalCompanion);
+
+    final inserted = await _dao.getById(id);
+    final payload = BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(inserted!.toJson());
+    await syncHelper.recordInsert(
+      entityType: 'law',
+      entityId: id,
+      payload: payload,
+      changedFields: payload.keys.toList(),
+    );
+
+    return id;
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> update(LawsCompanion companion, {Law? base}) async {
+    final id = companion.id.value;
+    final existing = base ?? await _dao.getById(id);
+    if (existing == null) {
+      throw StateError('Cannot update law $id: not found');
+    }
+
+    final now = BaseLocalRepository.nowMillis;
+    final userId = currentUserId;
+
+    final finalCompanion = companion.copyWith(
+      isUserModified: const Value(true),
+      updatedAt: Value(now),
+      lastModifiedBy: Value(userId),
+    );
+
+    await _dao.update(finalCompanion);
+
+    final updated = await _dao.getById(id);
+    final payload = BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(updated!.toJson());
+    final changed = _changedFields(finalCompanion);
+
+    await syncHelper.recordUpdate(
+      entityType: 'law',
+      entityId: id,
+      payload: payload,
+      changedFields: changed,
+      basePayload: BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(existing.toJson()),
+      baseVersion: existing.version,
+      preMutationPayload: BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(existing.toJson()),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> delete(Law law) async {
+    if (!law.isCustom) {
+      throw StateError('Cannot delete built-in law ${law.id}');
+    }
+    final now = BaseLocalRepository.nowMillis;
+    final userId = currentUserId;
+
+    await _dao.delete(law.id, now);
+
+    await syncHelper.recordDelete(
+      entityType: 'law',
+      entityId: law.id,
+      payload: BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(<String, dynamic>{
+        'id': law.id,
+        'isDeleted': true,
+        'updatedAt': now,
+        'lastModifiedBy': userId,
+      }),
+      changedFields: ['is_deleted', 'updated_at', 'last_modified_by'],
+      basePayload: BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(law.toJson()),
+      baseVersion: law.version,
+      preMutationPayload: BaseLocalRepository.toSyncPayload(law.toJson()),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<Law?> getById(String id) => _dao.getById(id);
+
+  @override
+  Future<List<Law>> listAll({int? limit, int? offset}) =>
+      _dao.getAll(limit: limit, offset: offset);
+
+  @override
+  Stream<List<Law>> watchAll({int? limit, int? offset}) =>
+      _dao.watchAll(limit: limit, offset: offset);
+
+  List<String> _changedFields(LawsCompanion companion) {
+    final fields = <String>[];
+    if (companion.name.present) fields.add('name');
+    if (companion.orderIndex.present) fields.add('order_index');
+    return fields;
+  }
+}

+/// Laws DAO: local data access for the law-name list.
+///
+/// The list is small (a dozen or so rows), so the DAO is the plain cour/step
+/// shape: ordered reads, one reactive watch, and a soft delete. Ordering is
+/// `order_index` first — the seed order, and whatever the user reorders it to —
+/// then the name, so two rows added at the same position still read A→Z.
+library;
+
+import 'package:drift/drift.dart';
+
+import '../../../../database/app_database.dart';
+
+/// Data Access Object for [Laws] table operations.
+class LawsDao {
+  /// Creates a DAO backed by [db].
+  LawsDao(this.db);
+
+  /// The Drift database instance.
+  final AppDatabase db;
+
+  /// Returns all non-deleted law names in display order.
+  Future<List<Law>> getAll({int? limit, int? offset}) async {
+    final query = db.select(db.laws)
+      ..where((row) => row.isDeleted.equals(false))
+      ..orderBy([
+        (row) => OrderingTerm(expression: row.orderIndex),
+        (row) => OrderingTerm(expression: row.name),
+      ]);
+    if (limit != null) {
+      query.limit(limit, offset: offset ?? 0);
+    }
+    return query.get();
+  }
+
+  /// Reactive stream of all non-deleted law names in display order.
+  Stream<List<Law>> watchAll({int? limit, int? offset}) {
+    final query = db.select(db.laws)
+      ..where((row) => row.isDeleted.equals(false))
+      ..orderBy([
+        (row) => OrderingTerm(expression: row.orderIndex),
+        (row) => OrderingTerm(expression: row.name),
+      ]);
+    if (limit != null) {
+      query.limit(limit, offset: offset ?? 0);
+    }
+    return query.watch();
+  }
+
+  /// Returns a law name by id, or null if not found or deleted.
+  Future<Law?> getById(String id) async => (db.select(db.laws)
+        ..where((row) => row.id.equals(id) & row.isDeleted.equals(false)))
+      .getSingleOrNull();
+
+  /// Returns the highest `order_index` in use, or -1 when the list is empty.
+  ///
+  /// A new name appends after it, so a freshly typed law never lands at the
+  /// top of the list or shares position 0 with the whole seed.
+  Future<int> maxOrderIndex() async {
+    final row = await (db.selectOnly(db.laws)
+          ..addColumns([db.laws.orderIndex.max()])
+          ..where(db.laws.isDeleted.equals(false)))
+        .getSingle();
+    return row.read(db.laws.orderIndex.max()) ?? -1;
+  }
+
+  /// Inserts a law name. Returns the affected row count.
+  Future<int> insert(LawsCompanion law) => db.into(db.laws).insert(law);
+
+  /// Updates a law name. Returns true if a row was affected.
+  Future<bool> update(LawsCompanion law) async =>
+      await (db.update(
+        db.laws,
+      )..where((row) => row.id.equals(law.id.value))).write(law) >
+      0;
+
+  /// Soft-deletes a law name by id.
+  Future<int> delete(String id, int updatedAt) =>
+      (db.update(db.laws)..where((row) => row.id.equals(id))).write(
+        LawsCompanion(
+          isDeleted: const Value(true),
+          updatedAt: Value(updatedAt),
+        ),
+      );
+}

--
-- Every sync write goes through this one RPC instead of direct table upserts,
-- per implementation plan §1.1. One outer transaction, one implicit savepoint
-- per logical mutation (a PL/pgSQL `begin ... exception ... end` block), a
-- deterministic result for exactly one mutation_id in input order, and a
-- receipt per terminal result so a retry can never apply twice.

-- tables and reads/writes the server-managed `mutation_receipts` ledger. The
-- pull-only caches, preference tables and every other server-managed table are
-- deliberately out of reach: `sync_entity_table` maps only the domain set.

-- wire shape and the local columns are the same names.

-- FK-safe ordering: the six editable config tables first, then `cases`, then
-- everything that may reference a case or is a leaf. Within a rank the batch's
-- input order is preserved.
create or replace function public.sync_dependency_rank(p_entity_type text)
returns integer
language sql
immutable
set search_path = pg_catalog, public
as $$
  select case public.sync_entity_table(p_entity_type)
    when 'court_categories' then 0
    when 'case_categories' then 0
    when 'courts' then 0

    when 'case_types' then 0

    when 'case_history' then 2
    when 'notes' then 2
    when 'case_references' then 2
    when 'delete_requests' then 2
    when 'conflict_log' then 2
    else 3
  end;
$$;

class _LawList extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LawList({
    required this.repo,
    required this.laws,
    required this.categoryId,
  });

  final LawsRepository repo;
  final List<Law> laws;

  /// The route's category id; `other` stands for the blank/unknown group.
  final String categoryId;

  String get _resolvedCategoryId => categoryId == 'other' ? '' : categoryId;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    // The category page's own group. A category with no rows yet — a heading
    // whose names were all removed — simply shows the empty state.
    var rows = const <Law>[];
    for (final group in groupLaws(laws)) {
      if (group.categoryId == _resolvedCategoryId) {
        rows = group.laws;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (rows.isEmpty) {
      return Center(child: Text(l.lawNamesScreen_empty));
    }

    return ReorderableListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(AppSpacing.md),
      itemCount: rows.length,
      onReorderItem: (oldIndex, newIndex) => _reorder(rows, oldIndex, newIndex),
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final law = rows[index];
        return Card(
          key: ValueKey(law.id),
          elevation: 0,
          color: AppColors.surface,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            side: BorderSide(color: AppColors.surfaceContainer),
          ),
          child: ListTile(
            leading: const Icon(
              Icons.drag_indicator,
              color: AppColors.tertiary,
            ),
            title: Text(law.name, style: AppTypography.bodyLg),
            trailing: Row(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_outlined),
                  onPressed: () => _edit(context, law),
                  tooltip: l.sharedActions_edit,
                ),
                // A built-in law is part of the app's shared vocabulary; only a
                // name the user added can be removed.
                if (law.isCustom)
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.delete_outline,
                      color: AppColors.error,
                    ),
                    onPressed: () => _delete(context, law),
                    tooltip: l.sharedActions_delete,
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _edit(BuildContext context, Law law) async {
    final draft = await showLawNameDialog(
      context,
      editing: true,
      initialName: law.name,
      initialCategoryId: law.category.isEmpty ? categoryId : law.category,
    );
    if (draft == null) return;
    await repo.update(
      LawsCompanion(
        id: Value(law.id),
        name: Value(draft.name),
        category: Value(draft.categoryId),
      ),
      base: law,
    );
  }

  Future<void> _delete(BuildContext context, Law law) async {
    final l = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final confirmed = await showAppDialog<bool>(
      context,
      title: Text(l.settingsItemList_deleteTitle, textAlign: TextAlign.center),
      content: Text(l.settingsItemList_deleteMessage),
      actions: (dialogContext) => [
        AppDialogAction(
          label: l.sharedActions_cancel,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(false),
        ),
        AppDialogAction(
          label: l.sharedActions_delete,
          kind: AppDialogActionKind.destructive,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(true),
        ),
      ],
    );
    if (confirmed == true) await repo.delete(law);
  }

  /// Reorders the rows the user sees and writes back their slots.
  ///
  /// The rows keep the `order_index` values this group already held, sorted and
  /// handed out in the new order. Renumbering the whole law table would touch
  /// the six other groups' rows and queue fifty sync writes for one drag, while
  /// reusing the group's own slots keeps every other category untouched and
  /// cannot collide with it.
  Future<void> _reorder(List<Law> rows, int oldIndex, int newIndex) async {
    if (oldIndex == newIndex) return;
    final reordered = List<Law>.from(rows);
    final moved = reordered.removeAt(oldIndex);
    reordered.insert(newIndex, moved);
    final slots = rows.map((law) => law.orderIndex).toList()..sort();
    for (var i = 0; i < reordered.length; i++) {
      if (reordered[i].orderIndex == slots[i]) continue;
      await repo.update(
        LawsCompanion(id: Value(reordered[i].id), orderIndex: Value(slots[i])),
        base: reordered[i],
      );
    }
  }
}
